paragraphs.text: The staff kitchen on the second floor is available to all employees from 7.30 am to 6 pm. Cleaners empty the fridge every Friday at 4 pm, so please take home anything you want to keep.
Each team is responsible for washing its own cups and plates. Dishes left in the sink at the end of the day will be removed and placed in the lost property box at reception.

The coffee machine is serviced on the first Monday of each month and cannot be used until 11 am on that day. Tea, milk and sugar are provided free of charge; coffee pods must be bought from reception at 30p each.
For safety reasons, kettles and toasters brought from home must not be used in the kitchen. Please report any faulty equipment to the facilities team by email.
The large table can be booked for team lunches through the room booking system at least two days in advance. Please do not hold meetings in the kitchen between 12 and 2 pm, when it is busiest.

items.quote: Cleaners empty the fridge every Friday at 4 pm, so please take home anything you want to keep
items.prompt: Food left in the fridge on Friday afternoon may be thrown away.

explanation.en: “empty the fridge every Friday at 4 pm, so please take home anything you want to keep” — whatever is left is removed → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «empty the fridge every Friday at 4 pm, so please take home anything you want to keep» — қалған заттың бәрі алынып тасталады → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «empty the fridge every Friday at 4 pm, so please take home anything you want to keep» — всё, что осталось, убирают → TRUE.

items.quote: Each team is responsible for washing its own cups and plates
items.prompt: Cleaners wash the dishes at the end of each day.

explanation.en: “Each team is responsible for washing its own cups and plates” — teams wash them. Dishes left behind go to reception, not to be washed → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «Each team is responsible for washing its own cups and plates» — ыдысты әр топ өзі жуады. Қалып қойған ыдысты жумайды, қабылдау бөлмесіне апарады → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «Each team is responsible for washing its own cups and plates» — моют сами команды. Оставленную посуду уносят на ресепшн, а не моют → FALSE.

items.quote: cannot be used until 11 am on that day
items.prompt: The coffee machine cannot be used at all on its service day.

explanation.en: “cannot be used until 11 am” — only until 11, after that it works. “At all” contradicts the text → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «cannot be used until 11 am» — тек таңғы 11-ге дейін, кейін пайдалануға болады. «At all» мәтінге қайшы → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «cannot be used until 11 am» — только до 11 утра, потом можно. «At all» противоречит тексту → FALSE.

items.quote: Tea, milk and sugar are provided free of charge
items.prompt: Staff do not have to pay for milk.

explanation.en: “Tea, milk and sugar are provided free of charge” → TRUE. Only the coffee pods are paid for.
explanation.kk: «Tea, milk and sugar are provided free of charge» → TRUE. Тек кофе капсулалары ақылы.
explanation.ru: «Tea, milk and sugar are provided free of charge» → TRUE. Платные только капсулы для кофе.

items.quote: kettles and toasters brought from home must not be used in the kitchen
items.prompt: Employees can buy a kettle from reception.

explanation.en: Kettles from home are banned, and reception sells coffee pods. Whether reception sells kettles is not stated → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Үйден әкелген шәйнекке тыйым салынған; қабылдау бөлмесінде кофе капсулалары сатылады. Шәйнек сатыла ма, айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Запрещены чайники из дома; на ресепшне продают кофейные капсулы. Продаются ли там чайники, не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Look at the text. Do the following statements agree with the information given in the text? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.
